title: File header requirement
rule_text: A D2021 file must start with exactly one ZHV file header record.
recommended_action: Reject the file and request a corrected D2021 file when the header is missing or duplicated.

title: File trailer requirement
rule_text: A D2021 file must end with exactly one ZPT file trailer record.
recommended_action: Reject the file and request a corrected D2021 file when the trailer is missing or duplicated.

title: Mandatory record hierarchy
rule_text: A charge record must be associated with an invoice record. An invoice record must be associated with a site and at least one MPAN record.
recommended_action: Review the CLO, MPC, BCD and CCD record sequence and identify the missing parent record.

title: Invoice number requirement
rule_text: Every invoice must contain a non-empty invoice number that is unique within the uploaded file.
recommended_action: Check the BCD record and confirm the invoice number and duplicate-file status.

title: Invoice date validation
rule_text: Invoice dates and invoice-period dates must use the YYYYMMDD format, and the period start date must not exceed the period end date.
recommended_action: Verify the invoice date and billing-period values in the BCD record.

title: Credit invoice sign
rule_text: Credit invoice net, VAT and gross values must be zero or negative.
recommended_action: Review the credit invoice values and the referenced original invoice before processing.

title: Rebill invoice sign
rule_text: Rebill or replacement invoice net, VAT and gross values must be zero or positive.
recommended_action: Review the replacement invoice values and confirm the relationship with the original invoice.

title: Core MPAN format
rule_text: A Core MPAN must contain exactly 13 numeric digits.
recommended_action: Verify the MPC record and correct the MPAN format before further processing.

title: MPAN presence
rule_text: Every invoice must be associated with at least one MPAN record.
recommended_action: Review the CLO and MPC hierarchy and identify the missing MPAN association.

title: MPAN active period
rule_text: The MPAN must be active for the complete invoice billing period.
recommended_action: Compare the invoice period with the MPAN effective-from and effective-to dates in the MPAN master data.

title: Invoice financial total
rule_text: The invoice net amount plus VAT must equal the invoice gross amount within the configured monetary tolerance.
recommended_action: Review the BCD net, VAT and gross values and confirm the applicable rounding rule.

title: BCD and CCD reconciliation
rule_text: The BCD final net amount must equal the sum of the associated CCD billed charge amounts within the configured tolerance.
recommended_action: Compare every CCD amount with the BCD final net value and investigate missing, duplicated or invalid charge records.

title: Capacity charge review
rule_text: An unusually high capacity charge must be reviewed against the agreed capacity, billing days, applicable rate and effective tariff period.
recommended_action: Confirm the capacity quantity, rate, billing days and tariff effective dates.

title: Unit charge review
rule_text: An unusually high unit charge must be reviewed against consumption, time-band rate and tariff effective dates.
recommended_action: Check billed consumption and the Red, Amber or Green unit rate used for the invoice period.

title: Reactive charge review
rule_text: An unusually high reactive-power charge must be reviewed against reactive consumption and the applicable reactive rate.
recommended_action: Review reactive consumption, meter values and the reactive-power tariff.

title: Statistical anomaly interpretation
rule_text: A machine-learning anomaly indicates that an invoice differs statistically from the comparison population. It does not independently confirm a billing error or fraud.
recommended_action: Review the unusual features and supporting invoice evidence before making a billing decision.

title: Human review requirement
rule_text: Critical, high and medium-risk invoices must receive human review before a final processing decision is recorded.
recommended_action: Assign the invoice to a reviewer and record the decision, comments and supporting evidence.
